@echo off
REM ============================================================================
REM  USAIndiaCFO device SETUP (one file). Double-click to install everything.
REM  Self-elevates (UAC), asks for the work token, then sets up watcher + SEB +
REM  power + Wi-Fi + run-at-logon tasks. The setup PowerShell is embedded below.
REM  NOTE: antivirus/SmartScreen may warn (kiosk + tasks). Sign or allowlist it.
REM ============================================================================
setlocal
set "DASH=https://seo.usaindiacfo.us"
set "TOKEN=%~1"
net session >nul 2>&1
if %errorlevel% neq 0 (
  if "%TOKEN%"=="" set /p "TOKEN=Paste this employee work token (dashboard - Device setup - Get token): "
  powershell -NoProfile -Command "Start-Process -FilePath '%~f0' -Verb RunAs -ArgumentList '%TOKEN%'"
  exit /b
)
if "%TOKEN%"=="" set /p "TOKEN=Paste this employee work token: "
if "%TOKEN%"=="" ( echo No token entered. & pause & exit /b 1 )
set "B64=%TEMP%\uic-device-setup.b64"
set "PS1=%TEMP%\uic-device-setup.ps1"
if exist "%B64%" del "%B64%"
>"%B64%" echo 
>>"%B64%" echo 
>>"%B64%" echo 
>>"%B64%" echo 
>>"%B64%" echo 
>>"%B64%" echo 
>>"%B64%" echo 
>>"%B64%" echo 
>>"%B64%" echo 
>>"%B64%" echo 
>>"%B64%" echo 
>>"%B64%" echo 
>>"%B64%" echo 
>>"%B64%" echo 
>>"%B64%" echo 
>>"%B64%" echo 
>>"%B64%" echo 
>>"%B64%" echo 
>>"%B64%" echo 
>>"%B64%" echo 
>>"%B64%" echo 
>>"%B64%" echo 
>>"%B64%" echo 
certutil -f -decode "%B64%" "%PS1%" >nul
del "%B64%" >nul 2>&1
powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -NoExit -File "%PS1%" -Dashboard "%DASH%" -Token "%TOKEN%"
endlocal
